title: Job
description: DRAFT — no real Job record exists yet (the pipeline is currently a local CLI, pipeline/run.py). This is the canonical shape for the DynamoDB `Job` item from .kiro/steering/architecture.md, filled in with a `stage` enum taken 1:1 from run.py's real, comment-documented stage order (chat -> audio extract/upload -> Transcribe -> Rekognition -> fusion -> Director -> render) so it can double as the state-name basis for the eventual Step Functions machine.

status.description: Coarse job outcome. Poll `GET /jobs/{id}` (WebSocket push is primary; this is the fallback per architecture.md).

stage.description: Current pipeline stage. Order mirrors pipeline/run.py exactly: 1 chat signals, 2 audio extract/upload, 3 Transcribe, 4 Rekognition (visual), 5 fusion, 6 AI Director (Bedrock), 7 render. Chat/audio/Transcribe/Rekognition fan out in parallel in the cloud version (architecture.md); this enum still lists them in run.py's sequential-fallback order for readability.

targets.description: Platform selections, consumed at export time for aspect ratio/duration/bitrate.

vertical.description: Selects the fusion weight preset from config/weights.json (e.g. "talk", "gaming"). Config-over-redeploy per architecture.md non-negotiables.

sourceKey.description: S3 key of the uploaded raw VOD.

proxyKey.description: S3 key of the MediaConvert-produced low-res proxy (analysis + browser editor run against this, not the source).

progress.description: Pushed over the API Gateway WebSocket on each Step Functions state transition.

stage.description: Duplicates top-level `stage`; included so a progress event is self-contained.

counts.description: Populated once fusion/Director have run. Drives "N highlights found" in the UI. Pipeline: len(candidates), len([h for h in highlights if h.keep]).

candidates.description: Candidate windows fusion produced, pre-Director filtering.

kept.description: Highlights the Director kept (== number of Clip rows written).

error.description: Set when status is FAILED; null otherwise.
